name: context-handoff
description: Detect context compaction and transfer long-running Codex work into a fresh verified thread without losing acceptance criteria or evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Detect context pressure and continue in a verified fresh thread
interface.longDescription: Detect compaction with a trusted local lifecycle hook, keep context-health review active on later turns, and safely checkpoint a long-running Codex task. Preserve its goal, reply language, acceptance criteria, evidence, workspace identity, and open risks, then continue in a fresh thread only after a destination regression sentinel passes.
defaultPrompt: Checkpoint this task and continue it in a fresh verified thread.
Prepare a safe handoff packet for this long-running Codex task.
Check context health and hand off only if a fresh thread is warranted.
